artworks.title: Don Quixote about to Strike the Helmet
artworks.medium: brush with brown and gray washes over charcoal on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic pose, swinging a sword. The individual is standing with legs apart, one arm raised above their head holding the sword, and the other resting on their hip. The facial features are sketched with strong lines, and the hair appears pulled back. The person is wearing historical or costume-like clothing, including a loose top, possibly a vest, and trousers tucked into boots. Nearby objects include a helmet on a stand or stool, and a round shield leaning against furniture. The background features arched structures, possibly representing the interior of a room with a cluttered appearance.

artworks.title: The Muleteer Attacking Don Quixote as He Lies Helpless on the Ground
artworks.medium: brush with brown and gray washes over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a battle scene. In the foreground, an individual dressed in loose clothing is shown holding a sword aloft, poised to strike a fallen armored figure. The fallen figure is depicted lying on the ground with a sword nearby, wearing full plate armor and looking upward. In the background, other figures and possibly horses are indicated with swift lines, suggesting chaos and movement. The composition conveys intensity and action, capturing a moment of combat with energetic pencil strokes. The sketchy style of the drawing explores form and movement, evoking the tumult of a medieval or mythological battle.

artworks.title: Don Quixote Attacking the Windmill
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on horseback in a dynamic pose. The figure appears to be wearing armor and is holding a weapon. The horse is in a dynamic pose in a chaotic environment with falling beams. The background includes foliage and a disrupted structure. The drawing has loose, sketchy lines and washes of brown, creating a sense of motion and action. The composition is filled with diagonal lines that suggest movement and chaos.

artworks.title: Don Quixote Defeated by the Windmill
artworks.medium: brush with brown and gray washes over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fallen knight in armor on the ground with a sword. The knight appears to be lying on a rustic landscape, with an arm outstretched clutching a shield, while trees and a windmill provide environment in the background. Light, sketchy lines characterize the style, with quick strokes suggesting movement and detailing. The background features suggestive outlines of people in the midst of action.

artworks.title: Don Quixote Attacking the Biscayan
artworks.medium: brush with brown and gray washes over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval battle scene. The illustration depicts armored soldiers engaged in combat, including some on horseback. Various elements in motion are featured, such as horses rearing, knights brandishing swords, and overturned objects. The lines are loose and expressive, conveying the urgency and intensity of the scene. Shading techniques provide depth to the figures and suggest movement. The drawing is detailed yet sketched, leaving room for the viewer's interpretation. It could be a preparatory sketch for a more polished artwork.

artworks.title: Don Quixote and Sancho Panza Witness the Attack on Rocinante
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a wooded area with two figures interacting. The scene is sketched in a monochromatic palette, using predominately sepia tones. One figure sits on the left in elaborate armor, gazing downward. The other figure on the right is partially obscured by a tree, pointing toward the distance or at something out of view. Surrounding these figures are thick tree trunks and foliage, providing a sense of enclosure and depth. The setting suggests an outdoor woodland environment, with a glimpse of mountains or hills faintly in the background. The style of the drawing suggests a historical or narrative context, possibly capturing an event or moment in a story.

artworks.title: View of the Rialto Bridge, Venice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with a stone bridge on the left side. The bridge has small figures crossing it. Buildings line both sides of the canal with intricate architectural details. Boats, including gondolas and larger vessels, are in the water. Some boats are being navigated by individuals with long poles. The sky is partially visible and has soft blues and grays. The color palette consists of browns, grays, and blues. The brushwork is detailed and precise, capturing the architectural splendor and water life of Venice.

artworks.title: A Cleric Accompanying a Lady on Her Morning Walk
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite on beige laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing. The man on the left has his arm raised towards the woman on the right. He is dressed in 18th-century attire with a dog near his feet. The woman on the right holds a walking stick and adjusts her headwear. The background features sketches of buildings and rooftops.

artworks.title: A Lady and Gentleman with Exaggerated Headdresses
artworks.medium: red chalk on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman engaged in conversation. The woman stands with a slightly turned posture, facing the man with her body angled to the left. She has elaborate curls and decorations on her head, and holds a fan in one hand. The man holds a small dog in his arm, with a smiling expression. Both wear clothing reminiscent of 18th-century fashion, with detailed buttons and textures. In the background, there is a stone structure on the left and a faint outline of another couple in similar attire walking in the distance. The image is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: View of the Hôtel des Fermes Générales du Tabac
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash and watercolor over graphite on two sheet of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene depicting the front view of a grand building with carriages in front. The drawing shows a symmetrical facade of a large building with a central archway and multiple windows along its length. In the foreground, various carriages and people are engaging in different activities, contributing to a bustling but orderly ambiance. The use of perspective and architectural details like statues and carvings emphasize the grandeur of the building. The color palette gives the drawing a historical and classical feel.

artworks.title: Roman Prison
artworks.artist: French 18th Century Follower of Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and gray wash heightened with white gouache over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grand architectural interior with a network of staircases. The image features a vast, labyrinthine space with multiple levels and arches. The central focus is a large pillar with a decorated capital, supporting a high arched ceiling. Staircases lead up and down in various directions, creating a sense of depth and complexity. The walls are adorned with classical architectural elements such as pediments and pilasters, and an intricate railing runs along the staircases. The painting uses a palette of earthy tones, highlighting the rustic textures of stone and brick. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Piranesi.

artworks.title: Courtyard of the Villa Pliniana
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown-gray wash and watercolor on beige laid paper

artworks.title: Ballet from "The Rival Fairies"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on light beige laid paper, with a loose border line by the artist in pen and gray ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand ball or dance scene. The image depicts a group of figures elegantly dressed in flowing gowns and elaborate costumes partaking in a courtly dance inside a palatial hall. The intricate pencil and ink lines suggest movement and grace. The figures are in motion, some twirling while others maintain poised gestures. The background features ornate architectural details with tall columns and arches, enhancing the grandeur of the setting. This is rendered with light shading and careful line work, creating a sense of depth and drama. The drawing conveys an atmosphere of elegance and celebration.

artworks.title: Sketches of Dancers and Heads of Putti
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing features sketched figures and cherubic faces. The left side shows rough sketches of groups of figures in various poses. The right side displays three cherubic faces drawn with cursory strokes, highlighted with swirling lines. The faces are arranged vertically, adding a playful tone to the composition. The style of the drawing and free-flowing lines suggest a dynamic sketch capturing the lively motion of the figures.

artworks.title: Royal Review of the Troops
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk, pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated point of view, showing a lively view of the activity below. The horizon line is high in the composition, with a cluster of trees painted in light greens and blues. The style features sketch-like brown ink lines highlighting human figures and scene details. There are people and carriages in shades of grey and brown ink with white highlights, suggesting movement and interaction. In the background, there is a procession fading into a lightly sketched background. Soft washes of color define the landscape, creating depth. The overall palette is subtle and earthy, with muted tones.

artworks.title: May Ball
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and gray wash, watercolor, and gouache, heightened with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a ballroom scene. The composition shows an elegant and festive ballroom filled with many guests. Dancers, dressed in opulent costumes, are dancing in pairs in the center. The upper balconies are filled with onlookers. Large chandeliers illuminate the room, and garland decorations hang from the ceiling. Luxurious detailing, such as intricate fabric patterns and elaborate hairstyles, is prominent. This painting is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

artworks.title: Project for the House and Gardens of Mlle. Guimard
artworks.artist: Jean Testard and Charles-Philippe Campion de Tersan
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper, with a color etching by Le Campion attached to the sheet at lower right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural plans and elevations for a garden and its associated buildings. The image contains a layout plan of a formal garden with sections labeled "jardin" and "potager." The design features pathways, garden sections, and a central circular fountain or feature. Additionally, there are side sections for a farmyard and stables. The right side of the image showcases elevation drawings of a grand building with classical architectural elements including columns and entrances. There is also a smaller circular illustration showing another detailed facade view.

artworks.title: Italian Comedians Taking Their Bows
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite on cream laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The image uses soft, sketchy lines in a reddish hue on a light background. The figures are arranged informally, some facing the viewer, others interacting. Architectural elements like columns or pillars frame the group. Gestural lines convey movement and vitality, while shading adds volume to the figures and space.

artworks.title: A Young Girl Wearing a Flowered Hat
artworks.medium: red chalk on light beige laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts the upper half of a woman's body. She is slightly turned to her right, with her face towards the viewer. Her facial features are softly portrayed, with a gentle expression and eyes looking forward. She has styled hair under a large decorated hat with flowers. The woman is wearing a detailed outfit with ruffled accents around the neckline and sleeves. Her hands are lifted towards her chest, lightly touching. The image has a textured background with cross-hatched shading to enhance the figure.

artworks.title: Le Petit Parc
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with dense vegetation, stone structures, pathways, and a small bridge or pathway in the distance with two figures. The artwork is an intricate etching in a monochrome palette of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: Le Petit Parc
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with detailed foliage, including a terrace with seated figures and stone steps leading into the greenery. Trees form a canopy over the composition. In the distance, there is an open space between foliage. The artwork features intricate lines and a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: A Ceiling Decoration with Landscapes and Battles
artworks.medium: pen, brown ink, watercolor and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative ceiling design. It features a square-grid design with intricate embellishments, including arched shapes with figures, elaborative scrollwork, and relief patterns. The color palette consists of earthy tones with hints of delicate blues in the central square area. The symmetrical composition reveals classical elements with a focus on the center.

artworks.title: Eichhorn Castle at Evening
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point with a view over a valley. The sky is filled with clouds and there are distant rolling hills on the horizon. The painting features precise brushstrokes capturing architectural and natural details. The color palette includes earthy greens and browns in the landscape, contrasting with the light stone and reddish roofs of a building complex. In the foreground, there are grassy slopes with small paths where people are walking.

artworks.title: The Three Marys
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (corners trimmed off): 15 x 13.8 cm (5 7/8 x 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features three women standing and facing left. The first woman blows a horn while holding an object. The second holds a lidded urn against her chest, and the third holds a similar urn with her left arm while draping a cloth over her shoulder with her right hand. The women have delicately drawn facial features and detailed hair and wear flowing robes. Each woman holds a distinct object, likely an urn. The background is minimal, with the focus on the figures.
